motion: At 0–1s the orange SOULI rocks eagerly toward the hanging espresso drop. The drop lands on its flat top at 1.5s with a small splash. From 2–5s SOULI itself makes three increasingly fast tiny sideways hops across the drip tray, left-right-left, each visibly lifting its entire base clear of the metal. Coffee droplets shake off. It stops slightly crooked, then slowly rights itself at 6–8s, pretending nothing happened.

The first raindrop hits SOULI at 0.7s. The yellow SOULI itself makes a quick sideways scoot to the left, moving half its body width along the wood. After a comic half-second delay the little raincloud slides left to catch up. SOULI then makes two small hops to the right, moving a full body width; the cloud follows again. At 6–8s SOULI visibly tips its whole body backward in disbelief and slowly slumps forward, still underneath the cloud. Keep the front design facing camera.

The robot vacuum starts moving slowly to the right at 0.5s. The gray SOULI independently tips backward on its base, then hops a short distance forward on the vacuum lid to regain balance. At 3s the vacuum makes a sudden gentle stop; SOULI slides forward and teeters at the lid edge, then makes one clear backward hop to safety. From 6–8s the vacuum resumes slowly and SOULI rocks its whole body triumphantly like a tiny surfer. Keep SOULI front-facing and visible.
